description_en: Modifies the configuration parameters of an existing scheduled task. You can specify the scheduled task ID to modify parameters such as the scaling rule to be executed, the number of instances in the scaling group, the task execution frequency, and the retry policy
description_zh: 如果当前伸缩组的定时任务不能满足业务需求，您可以调用ModifyScheduledTask接口，通过指定定时任务的ID修改已有定时任务的配置参数：需要执行的伸缩规则、伸缩组内实例数量、任务执行频率、重试策略等
name: ModifyScheduledTask

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scheduled task
parameters.name: scheduled_task_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the scheduled task. The name must be 2 to 64 characters in length and start with a letter, digit, or Chinese character. It can contain periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The name must be unique within the same region and Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh: 定时任务的名称。2-64个字符，以大小写字母、数字或中文开头，可包含（.）、下划线（_）或中划线（-）。同一账号同一地域内唯一
parameters.name: scheduled_task_name

parameters.help_en: The description of the scheduled task. The description must be 2 to 200 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 定时任务的描述信息。2-200个字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The unique identifier of the scaling rule. This parameter is available only when the scaling method is set to selecting an existing scaling rule. Select a created scaling rule and enter its unique identifier, which can be viewed on the scaling rule details page.

You cannot specify both ScheduledAction and ScalingGroupId at the same time
parameters.help_zh:
如果伸缩方式为选择已有伸缩规则时，才会出现该配置项，请您选择已创建的伸缩规则，填写伸缩规则的唯一标识符，可在伸缩规则详情页查看。

不支持同时设置`ScheduledAction`和`ScalingGroupId`
parameters.name: scheduled_action

parameters.help_en: The end time of the scheduled task for recurring execution. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC. You cannot specify a time that is later than 365 days from the date of modification
parameters.help_zh: 重复执行定时任务的结束时间。按照ISO8601标准表示，并需要使用UTC时间。格式为：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ。不能填写自修改当天起365日后的时间
parameters.name: recurrence_end_time

parameters.help_en:
The time at which the scheduled task is executed. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC. You cannot specify a time that is later than 90 days from the date of modification.

If RecurrenceType is specified, the time specified by this parameter is the default time for recurring execution.

If RecurrenceType is not specified, the task is executed only once at the specified date and time
parameters.help_zh:
定时任务执行的时间点。按照ISO8601标准表示，并需要使用UTC时间。格式为：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ。不能填写自修改当天起90日后的时间。

如果指定了`RecurrenceType`，则此属性指定的时间点，默认为循环执行的时间点。

如果未指定`RecurrenceType`，则按指定的日期和时间执行一次
parameters.name: launch_time

parameters.help_en:
The recurrence type of the scheduled task. Valid values:
 
Daily: The scheduled task is executed once every specified number of days.
Weekly: The scheduled task is executed on specified days of each week.
Monthly: The scheduled task is executed on specified days of each month.
Cron: The scheduled task is executed based on the specified cron expression.

After modification, both RecurrenceType and RecurrenceValue must be valid
parameters.help_zh:
设置定时任务重复的周期类型，支持按日、周、月等周期性执行。取值范围：
 
Daily：每多少天重复执行一次定时任务。
Weekly：每周指定几天重复执行一次定时任务。
Monthly：每月内指定几天重复执行一次定时任务。
Cron：按照指定的Cron表达式执行定时任务。

修改后，`RecurrenceType`和`RecurrenceValue`需要同时有效
parameters.name: recurrence_type

parameters.help_en:
The recurrence value of the scheduled task.

If RecurrenceType is set to Daily, only one value can be entered. Valid values: 1 to 31.
If RecurrenceType is set to Weekly, multiple values can be entered and must be separated by commas (,). For example, the values for Sunday, Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, and Saturday are 0,1,2,3,4,5,6.
If RecurrenceType is set to Monthly, the format is A-B. Valid values of A and B: 1 to 31. B must be greater than or equal to A.
If RecurrenceType is set to Cron, the value represents UTC time and supports a five-field expression for minutes, hours, days, months, and weeks. Wildcards such as commas (,), question marks (?), hyphens (-), asterisks (*), number signs (#), forward slashes (/), L, and W are supported.

After modification, both RecurrenceType and RecurrenceValue must be valid
parameters.help_zh:
定时任务重复执行的周期类型对应数值。

`RecurrenceType`取值为`Daily`时，只能填一个值，取值范围：1~31。
`RecurrenceType`取值为`Weekly`时，可以填入多个值，填多个值时使用半角逗号（,）分隔。例如，周日、周一、周二、周三、周四、周五、周六的值依次为：`0,1,2,3,4,5,6`。
`RecurrenceType`取值为`Monthly`时，格式为`A-B`。A、B的取值范围为1~31，并且B必须大于等于A。
`RecurrenceType`取值为`Cron`时，表示UTC时间，支持分、时、日、月、星期的五个域表达式，支持通配符半角逗号（,）、半角问号（?）、短划线（-）、星号（*）、井号（#）、正斜线（/）、L和W。

修改后，`RecurrenceType`和`RecurrenceValue`需要同时有效
parameters.name: recurrence_value

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the scheduled task. Valid values:

true: Enables the scheduled task.
false: Disables the scheduled task.

Default value: true
parameters.help_zh:
是否启动定时任务。取值范围：

true：启动定时任务。
false：停止定时任务。

默认值：true
parameters.name: task_enabled

parameters.help_en:
The period of time during which Auto Scaling retries to execute the scheduled task after the trigger operation fails. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 0 to 1800.

Default value: 600
parameters.help_zh:
定时任务触发操作失败后，弹性伸缩将在重试过期时间内继续尝试执行定时任务。单位为秒，取值范围：0~1800。

默认值：600
parameters.name: launch_expiration_time

parameters.help_en: The minimum number of instances in the scaling group. This parameter is available only when the scaling method of the scheduled task is set to specifying the number of instances in the scaling group
parameters.help_zh: 定时任务的伸缩方式为设置伸缩组内实例数量时，指定伸缩组内实例的最小数量
parameters.name: min_value

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of instances in the scaling group. This parameter is available only when the scaling method of the scheduled task is set to specifying the number of instances in the scaling group
parameters.help_zh: 定时任务的伸缩方式为设置伸缩组内实例数量时，指定伸缩组内实例的最大数量
parameters.name: max_value

parameters.help_en:
The expected number of instances in the scaling group. This parameter is available only when the scaling method of the scheduled task is set to specifying the number of instances in the scaling group.
The scaling group must support setting the expected number of instances. Specifically, DesiredCapacity must be specified when the scaling group is created
parameters.help_zh:
定时任务的伸缩方式为设置伸缩组内实例数量时，指定伸缩组内实例的期望实例数。
伸缩组必须支持设置期望实例数，即在创建该伸缩组时指定了`DesiredCapacity`
parameters.name: desired_capacity

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the scaling group for which you want to modify the number of instances when the scheduled task is triggered. This parameter is available only when the scaling method is set to specifying the number of instances in the scaling group. After you specify ScalingGroupId, you must specify a value for at least one of the following parameters: MinValue, MaxValue, and DesiredCapacity.

You cannot specify both ScheduledAction and ScalingGroupId at the same time
parameters.help_zh:
如果伸缩方式为设置伸缩组内实例数量，才会出现该配置项，请您填写定时任务触发时需要修改实例数量的伸缩组ID。指定`ScalingGroupId`后，您需要为`MinValue`、`MaxValue`和`DesiredCapacity`中至少一个参数指定数量。

不支持同时设置`ScheduledAction`和`ScalingGroupId`
parameters.name: scaling_group_id

fields.help_en: The expected number of warmed instances
fields.name: desired_group_prepared_capacity

fields.help_en: The minimum number of instances in the warm pool
fields.name: min_capacity

parameters.help_en: The warm pool capacity configuration of the scaling group. This parameter is valid only when a warm pool is configured for the scaling group
parameters.help_zh: 伸缩组预热池容量配置，只有伸缩组配置了预热池时才有效
parameters.name: warm_pool_capacity_options
